summary: GAMCO Natural Resources, Gold & Income Trust filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its at-the-market (ATM) sales agreement, allowing the Fund to sell up to 2,000,000 common shares at a minimum price of net asset value plus commission. This is an ordinary shelf takedown under Rule 415, not a transformative special situation. The filing includes a legal opinion from Skadden. No special-situation event; this is routine capital raising for a closed-end fund.
